content: {"episode_id":"ep-05024","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which the payer states was denied because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes. We request reconsideration of the authorization determination and payment of the outstanding balance of 581.63."}
